distanceMetric: camera world position to athlete world-space bounding-sphere center

overlap.definition: Full overlap width is 20% of threshold: threshold * [0.9, 1.1].
overlap.renderRecommendation: Complementary screen-space dither; near coverage 1-blend, far coverage blend. Both meshes share the same posed skeleton and morph weights.
overlap.hardSwitchFallback: Move outward only past overlapEndMeters; move inward only below overlapStartMeters (hysteresis).

appearance.lod2Hands: one closed mitten volume per hand, no separate fingers
appearance.hair: Separate optional accessory; excluded from body budgets. Budget or simplify separately before attachment.

recommendation: Starting distances for the reference camera, to tune against actual game framing; no runtime integration in this asset-only package.
